mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.book_id AS bookId, d.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(up.nickname, su.username) AS author, up.avatar AS authorAvatar, d.content, d.image_url AS imageUrl, d.parent_id AS parentId, d.create_time AS createTime FROM book_discussion d JOIN sys_user su ON d.user_id = su.id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON su.id = up.user_id AND up.deleted = 0 WHERE d.book_id = #{bookId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.parent_id IS NULL ORDER BY d.create_time DESC

SELECT d.id, d.book_id AS bookId, d.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(up.nickname, su.username) AS author, up.avatar AS authorAvatar, d.content, d.image_url AS imageUrl, d.parent_id AS parentId, d.create_time AS createTime FROM book_discussion d JOIN sys_user su ON d.user_id = su.id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_profile up ON su.id = up.user_id AND up.deleted = 0 WHERE d.book_id = #{bookId} AND d.deleted = 0 AND d.parent_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY d.create_time ASC
